净值已扣双边交易成本 10.0 bp（换手率 × 费率）；多空/十分层均含停牌股剔除（收益为 NaN 不参与）。
设计意图： Crossover of reversal-volume-confirmed (qualified parent, strong RankIC and ICIR) with a volatility regime gate (roughness from rejected parent). The reversal mechanism and volume rank are preserved as primary. The roughness ratio (ATR5/ATR20) acts as a lightweight modifier: when short-term volatility exceeds long-term volatility (roughness>1), the signal is fully applied; otherwise it is halved.

因子路由 / 公式 ⚠ FE DSL 暂不支持

(0.5 - ewm_mean(span=3, (close-low)/(high-low))) * ts_rank(63, volume/SMA_21(volume)) * (1.0 if ATR5/ATR20 > 1 else 0.5)
依赖列: open, high, low, close, volume

📚 字段与算子释义

输入字段

字段含义说明
open开盘价基础行情字段
high最高价基础行情字段
low最低价基础行情字段
close收盘价基础行情字段
volume成交量基础行情字段

算子

算子含义
ewm_meanewm_mean(x, span=n) → 指数加权移动平均 (EMA；span 控制衰减速度)
ts_rankts_rank(x, n) → 当前值在窗口内百分位
SMA_21SMA_21(x) → 21 期简单均线

🔬 陌生算子/字段释义

算子/字段含义
ts_eman 期指数移动平均（EWMA）
ts_rank滚动排名（当前值在 n 期窗口内的百分位排名）

📝 计算步骤（一步一步解释）

  1. 计算 range_：high - low
  2. 计算 safe_range：range_
  3. 计算 intra_pos：(close - low) / safe_range
  4. 计算 smoothed：intra_pos.ewm(span=3, adjust=False).mean()
  5. 计算 reversal：0.5 - smoothed
  6. 计算 vol_sma_21：volume.滚动窗口(21, min_periods=21).mean()
  7. 计算 vol_ratio：volume / vol_sma_21
  8. 计算 vol_rank：vol_ratio.滚动窗口(63, min_periods=63).rank(pct=True)
  9. 计算 tr：pd.concat([high - low
  10. 计算 atr5：tr.滚动窗口(5, min_periods=5).mean()
  11. 计算 atr20：tr.滚动窗口(20, min_periods=20).mean()
  12. 计算 roughness：atr5 / atr20
  13. 计算 regime：np.where(roughness > 1.0, 1.0, 0.5)
  14. 计算 factor：reversal * vol_rank * regime
  15. 计算 factor：factor

close收盘价基础行情字段

"kw">class="kw">def factor_reversal_volume_volregime(df): df_copy = df.copy() "com"># Primary mechanism "kw">class="kw">from crossover-reversal-volume-001: reversal with volume confirmation range_ = df_copy["str">'high'] - df_copy["str">'low'] safe_range = range_.replace(0.0, np.nan) intra_pos = (df_copy["str">'close'] - df_copy["str">'low']) / safe_range smoothed = intra_pos.ewm(span=3, adjust="kw">class="kw">False).mean() reversal = 0.5 - smoothed vol_sma_21 = df_copy["str">'volume'].rolling(21, min_periods=21).mean() vol_ratio = df_copy["str">'volume'] / vol_sma_21.replace(0, np.nan) vol_rank = vol_ratio.rolling(63, min_periods=63).rank(pct="kw">class="kw">True) "com"># Lightweight modifier "kw">class="kw">from rough_mom_crossover_001: volatility regime gate via roughness tr = pd.concat([df_copy["str">'high'] - df_copy["str">'low'], (df_copy["str">'high'] - df_copy["str">'close'].shift(1)).abs(), (df_copy["str">'low'] - df_copy["str">'close'].shift(1)).abs()], axis=1).max(axis=1) atr5 = tr.rolling(5, min_periods=5).mean() atr20 = tr.rolling(20, min_periods=20).mean() roughness = atr5 / atr20.replace(0.0, np.nan) regime = np.where(roughness > 1.0, 1.0, 0.5) factor = reversal * vol_rank * regime factor = factor.replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan).fillna(0) df_copy["str">'factor_reversal_volume_volregime'] = factor "kw">class="kw">return df_copy["str">'factor_reversal_volume_volregime']
